title: The Forest Guardian, 5 dollars
descriptionPlain: Description From the depths of the ancient forest emerges the Guardian, the embodiment of nature’s wisdom and guardian of harmony between the world of humans and the realm of trees. Ancient figure, known in many cultures under various names, from the Celtic Green Man to the Slavic Leshy and other forest spirits, symbolizes the living force of nature, renewal, and the unbroken cycle of life. His face, woven from leaves, branches, and moss, reminds us of the deep connection between humans and nature. Face Among the Leaves On the reverse of the coin, the Guardian takes on a tangible form. His face, sculpted in high relief, emerges from ivy leaves and delicate twigs that create a natural ornament. Every detail — the veins, textures, and play of light and shadow — enhances the organic character of the composition. The irregular edge of the coin completes the design, intensifying the three-dimensional effect and giving a distinctive appearance unseen in other issues of Mennica Polska. Protection and order The obverse of the coin carries the essential issuing elements, arranged in a clear and elegant composition. Subtle botanical motifs, the contrast of matte and polished surfaces, and a refined edge of the design bring depth and balance. The obverse design aims for a harmonious connection, evoking the story of the Guardian in a form that can be admired up close. Nature calms, allowing us to reflect on what life is really about. Signe Johansen
